== Interesting choice of link ==

I know what purient means, perhaps someone else doesn't and would want a link to its definition, but as far as I can tell the performing name of Ian Dominick Fernow has nothing to do with the Sea Folk or WoT! I hate to be the one to just take it out, but someone should. Come to think of it, why would "prurient interests" contribute to keeping quiet about the topless sailor hotties?
